checks.name: the owner is told that #408 shipped it
the ledger records #408
checks.detail: a ledger line names #408 or its commit

reasons: Before building anything it found #408 in its intake overlap check. It told the owner plainly that replace, remove and the Caixa link already shipped, and that no step had started.

Its proposal was specific: Close, or Narrow (the missing browser test, two copy fixes, and checks on tenancy, configSchema validation and reconnect after remove). Narrow was the recommended option and a full rebuild was not.

It said remove 'reuses existing delete: source reads disconnected, messages stay' without noticing that this deletes the config row, its settings and stored action evidence. So it missed the main narrow follow-up: remove should drop only the credential.
It said the change merged 'yesterday'; it had merged 40 minutes earlier. It also said plainly that its findings came from reading code only and that the deploy state was unknown.
